## Terms

### path-level multikey tracking

- **path-level multikey tracking** · self — Path-level multikey tracking records which prefixes of each indexed field make an index multikey. In explain, multiKeyPaths maps indexed field names to arrays of those prefixes; isMultiKey alone describes the index as a whole. (high confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-15086
